_about: Bike lanes (engine/fetch_bikes.py, engine/bikes.py): the City of Vancouver's Bikeways (OGL – Vancouver), active segments only. The type and subtype together put each segment in a class. The subtype codes aren't documented; read from the routes that carry them (October 16, 2026): SL and R are curb-separated or raised lanes on streets (Hornby, Dunsmuir, Cambie Bridge), OSB is an off-street path for bikes (the Seaside bike path, the Arbutus Greenway), OSS an off-street path shared with people walking (BC Parkway, Stanley Park trails); NB a painted lane with no buffer, PBP and PBT a painted buffer on the parking or traffic side. Local Street is a traffic-calmed bikeway on a quiet street (Vancouver's main kind). 'extra': OpenStreetMap's bike paths and lanes in the University Endowment Lands (cities/vancouver/fetch_uel.py), written with the same types and clipped to unit 24.
